title: How to Think Like a Computer Scientist: C++ Version
author: Allen B. Downey
description: A gentle introduction to programming and computer-science thinking using C++. Builds from variables, expressions, and functions up to recursion, classes, vectors, and larger programs, emphasising problem decomposition over syntax.
